unclebob\u00ae_mobile_app_free_fries.description:
🍟 FREE FRIES FOR YOUR FIRST APP ORDER! 🍟

Download. Order. Enjoy More with UNCLEBOB®.

How to Claim:
To enjoy your FREE Bob Potato Fries with any purchase of Set Meal on your first Mobile App order, please:
Add Ala Carte – Bob Potato Fries into your cart together with any Set Meal.
The app will automatically detect and apply the discount during checkout.
Complete payment and enjoy your FREE Fries.
No promo code required.

T&C
* Valid for first Mobile App order only.
* Applicable with purchase of any Set Meal.
* Customer must manually add Ala Carte – Bob Potato Fries into cart to enjoy the promotion.
* Discount will be auto-applied at checkout.
* Valid for pickup and delivery orders.
* Delivery fee (if applicable) will be borne by customer.
* Not valid with other ongoing promotions, vouchers, or discounts.
* While stocks last.
* UNCLEBOB® reserves the right to amend the terms & conditions without prior notice.
